name: Guihai Feng
source:
Occupation: Freelancer, and a senior clerk at the inn.
Talents: Despite her childish appearance, she can discern anything special in the environment around her. No detail can escape her eyes.
Personality: A calm, composed girl in the eyes of others. Poorly behaved around Xianchong.
Experience: Childhood friend of Xianchong who moved out. She has been doing different jobs since graduating from high school. She met Xianchong again at the inn.
